deltas.shared_contract_justification: Both main1480–1481 and1539–1541 use the same final primitive weight-two f from the original beta family and the exact modular-side conductor identity v_p(N)=a_p(U_f,ell), with a fresh auxiliary ell!=p for each p. The second occurrence combines this equality with already established bounds; it does not enlarge the source conclusion to an upper bound.
